exact_statement: For every integer q>=3 and integer d>=3, the nearest-neighbor ferromagnetic q-state Potts model on Z^d has positive spontaneous magnetization in a monochromatic infinite-volume state at its critical inverse temperature.

indicator_convention.Hamiltonian: H=-sum over unordered nearest-neighbor edges of 1_{equal spins}

source_convention.Hamiltonian: H_s=-sum sigma_x dot sigma_y on unit simplex spins
source_convention.slope_jump_conversion: Indicator pressure slope jump is multiplied by q/(q-1) in the simplex beta variable; affine pressure shifts do not change jumps.
